title: Rav Mesharshiya of Tusnaya

paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya of Tusnaya is mentioned in [Yevamot 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.21b.13): he sent to Rav Pappi, “Let our master teach us,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rav Mesharshiya sending his question to Rav Pappi. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2576&lang=en) gives the same wording but cites 21a.
The message opens with “Let our master teach us.” Hyman gives only the opening of the question.
